W1.evidence: `TemplateTag` no longer detects whether the argument is a function and subsequently calls it.

W4.evidence: Arguments in transformers are now checked on initialization as opposed to inside the hooks. This makes errors detectable earlier

W5.evidence: `TemplateTag` is now soft-deprecated. That means you can still use it, but it will print a helpful message that will guide you to the new API

H1-a.evidence: `createTag` is introduced as a replacement for `TemplateTag`. The days of adding `new` each time you want to combine some tags are over

H3.evidence: For more insight I recommend reading the tests in the linked commit

Y1.evidence: This may have been a bit convenient, but at the cost of code clarity, and it was also adding extra complication to the core function that should be as lean as possible

suggestion.description: Mentions the introduction of new features alongside breaking changes
